description: This file defines the CertVerifier class and related components for certificate verification in the Chromium project, including configuration, observer pattern, and verification request handling.

classes.name: CertVerifier
classes.description: Interface for verifying certificates, supporting multiple requests, configuration, and observer pattern.

classes.name: CertVerifier::Observer
classes.description: Observer interface for changes in CertVerifier configuration.

classes.name: CertVerifier::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for certificate verification, including revocation checking and trust anchors.

classes.name: CertVerifier::RequestParams
classes.description: Parameters for verifying a certificate against a hostname, including optional OCSP and SCT data.

classes.name: CertVerifierWithUpdatableProc
classes.description: A CertVerifier that can update its verification process while running.

methods.name: CertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Verifies a certificate asynchronously against a hostname with given parameters.

methods.name: CertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for configuration changes.

methods.name: CertVerifier::UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates the verification process data dynamically.
